result.final_answer: Cargo.toml declares 28 members under crates, in paired prefixes such as core, fx, session, turns, compute, pax, project, graph, wasm, decision, corpus, remote, native and inference; README.md says chip-core-0 is the base crate every other member builds on. Responsibilities: manifests mostly say only “owns one responsibility in the workspace,” so specific roles beyond chip-core-0 as base are not established. Dependencies: chip-core-0 has no internal deps; other crates depend on chip-core-0 plus selected earlier crates, forming layered internal deps; later examples include chip-native-26 on chip-inference-13, pax-5 and wasm-8, and chip-inference-27 on pax-5, decision-9 and inference-13. Each manifest shows serde/toml and dev tempfile. Manifests do not show APIs or runtime behavior.
